newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: AUTO IMPORTS INCLUDED IN CZECH DEPOSIT PLAN - FINMIN.
newsitem.headline: AUTO IMPORTS INCLUDED IN CZECH DEPOSIT PLAN - FINMIN.

text.p: Automobiles will be included in a Czech government plan to force importers to put a 20 percent deposit against the value of imports which takes effect on Monday, Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik said.
"Automobiles will be included in the programme," he told Reuters after a news conference for his Civic Democratic Party (ODS).
He did not give any further details.

On Wednesday, the government said it would impose a requirement on importers of consumer and agricultural goods to deposit either 20 percent or 60 percent of the value of their imports in non-interest bearing accounts for 180 days.

Industry and Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy said earlier on Thursday that the 20 percent deposit had been chosen. "I'm ready to announce it tomorrow at 1200 (1000 GMT)...and it will be valid from Monday," Dlouhy told a business conference.
